news.title: Third quarter 2026 earnings released: EPS: ₹0.88 (vs ₹4.03 loss in 3Q 2025)
news.body: Third quarter 2026 results: EPS: ₹0.88 (up from ₹4.03 loss in 3Q 2025). Revenue: ₹576.5m (up 123% from 3Q 2025). Net income: ₹4.43m (up ₹24.7m from 3Q 2025). Profit margin: 0.8% (up from net loss in 3Q 2025). The move to profitability was driven by higher revenue. Over the last 3 years on average, earnings per share has fallen by 54% per year but the company’s share price has only fallen by 24% per year, which means it has not declined as severely as earnings.

news.title: New major risk - Share price stability
news.body: The company's share price has been highly volatile over the past 3 months. It is more volatile than 90% of Indian stocks, typically moving 8.4% a week. This is considered a major risk. Share price volatility increases the risk of potential losses in the short-term as the stock tends to have larger drops in price more frequently than other stocks. It may also indicate the stock is highly sensitive to market conditions or economic conditions rather than being sensitive to its own business performance, which may also be inconsistent. Currently, the following risks have been identified for the company: Major Risks Share price has been highly volatile over the past 3 months (8.4% average weekly change). Earnings have declined by 48% per year over the past 5 years. Market cap is less than US$10m
